title: The New Geopolitics of Mining
gist: Ngaire Woods argues that Brazil's newly re-elected Lula government and Serbia's new post-Vučić government will be swept into the US-China scramble for critical minerals. Resource-rich governments must balance external pressure with domestic demands, and mining firms that fail to win local trust risk being thrown under the bus when public opinion sours.

insights.claim: In Brazil, incumbent President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva defeated far-right challenger Flávio Bolsonaro.
insights.speaker: @NgaireWoods
insights.so_what: Policy continuity in Brazil shapes the outlook for its mining and resource sector.
